verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say it creates a new daily note every day for journaling. They also show the daily note as the default capture destination: web bookmarks and highlights, audio transcriptions, deep-link appends and calendar meetings all land there. However, nothing in the evidence shows daily notes being pre-filled from a template, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: daily-note template pre-fill, any independent or hands-on corroboration of the daily-note workflow.
